notes:
Need to search first.I couldn't write these notes, because I didn't manage to read any sources.

My first try to open the pages you suggested failed: Enduring Word, Bible Hub's Gill, Ellicott and Pulpit Commentary pages, Precept Austin and the NET Bible notes. The fetch tool will only open a page after a search has returned it. When I then ran the searches, the tool said I had no more web calls left for this turn, so the searches never ran.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from memory. Writing the notes from my own knowledge would break that, so I've left them out entirely.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll start with searches limited to your approved sites, then read each page before writing anything. The plan is:
- **Traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Barnes) and Precept Austin.
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** Spurgeon on the watchmen (vv. 6–7), Desiring God on v. 5, Wesley's notes on wesley.nnu.edu, plus Reformed, Pentecostal and Lutheran teachers on things like the new name (v. 2) and who "Zion" means.
- **Other views:** the NET Bible notes for modern scholarship, and New Advent, Catholic Answers and OCA for Catholic and Orthodox readings, such as Zion read as the Church or as Mary.
